back_flavor: With one last parting glance, you exit the casino. You're confident that none of the dealers or security suspected you for anything other than what you pretended to be: just another hopeful gambler. Regardless of any money that you made or lost tonight, your real winnings will be the information that you were able to gather. You hope that it will be enough to prepare you for the improbable scheme that you must now concoct and pull off.
back_text: Each investigator who was defeated raises their alarm level by 2. If the investigators, as a group, possess 10 [per_investigator] or more resources, remember that you “cleaned out the house.” (→R2)
flavor: You must tread carefully, as arousing suspicion may ruin your plans before they have even begun.
name: Casing the Joint
text: [reaction] After you trigger the [action] ability on a [[Game]] location: Remove 1 clue from The Wellspring of Fortune (2 clues instead if you gained resources from the [[Game]] location's ability). Objective - Accomplish as many tasks as you can and get out before you are noticed! If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.

back_text:
If Abarran Arrigorriagakoa is still in play...
Just as you are ready to celebrate victory, a voice calls from the door behind you. "You come into my casino and steal from me?" Abarran stands there, shaking with fury. "You'll ruin everything I built. But I won't let you!" Any front of professionalism has been dropped. The true danger of the man has been revealed.
Move Abarran Arrigorriagakoa (Abarran Unleashed) to Relic Room.
If Abarran Arrigorriagakoa is in the victory display...
A ragged voice gasps from behind you. "I won't let you take it!" Abarran is somehow still on his feet in the doorway behind you. Although he looks ready to collapse, his eyes burn with hatred. Before you can stop him, he slams his fist against some kind of mechanism on the wall before slumping to the ground. Large sections of the solid steel ceiling begin to fall from above...
Each investigator must test [agility] (3). Each investigator who fails takes 2 damage.
flavor: The heist begins. You must open the vault door, locate the Wellspring, make it past the mystical defenses, and find a way to open the container that holds it.
name: The Take
text: [reaction] After you trigger the [action] ability on a [[Game]] location: Remove 1 clue from The Wellspring of Fortune (2 clues instead if you gained resources from the [[Game]] location's ability). Objective - If an investigator controls The Wellspring of Fortune, advance.

back_flavor: There were times when you weren't sure whether you would make it out of the casino with your skin and soul intact, but here you stand. It almost feels like a dream, but you can still hear a commotion inside. It's time to leave this place behind and make yourself scarce.
back_text: Each investigator who has not resigned is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma. (→R1)
flavor: Getting in was one thing, but now you must make it out with your prize. It feels as if the whole casino stands between you and the world outside.
name: The Exit
text: Each [[Casino]] enemy loses aloof and patrol. Each [[Casino]] enemy gains hunter and "Prey - Investigator that controls The Wellspring of Fortune." Objective - If the investigator with The Wellspring of Fortune has resigned, advance. (Beware - any investigator who has not resigned will be left behind!)

flavor: Standing in the center of the casino floor is overwhelming, with its dazzling interior and the clamor of well-to-do patrons.
name: Casino Floor
text: [action]: Resign. It's time to get out of here! [action]: Place an asset from your hand or play area facedown beneath Casino Floor, as part of your crew's "stash for the heist." (Limit once per turn.)

name: Casino Floor
text: [action]: Resign. It's time to get out of here! [action] If an investigator "impersonated a high roller" and your alarm level is 6 or lower, spend 2 resources: You set up a delivery to the vault. Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Casino]] enemy, spawn it here, and attach the set-aside Package Delivery story card to it. (Group limit once per game.)

back_flavor: The poker tables are constantly in demand, each game filled with players from around the continent and the world. Clattering fills the air as piles of chips are relentlessly pushed and stacked, each one a bet against destiny. The air is thick with smoke, sweat, and the tension of a good bluff.
flavor: Omaha 8-or-better, nothing's wild, sky's the limit.
name: Poker Table
text: [action] Spend 2 resources: Discard the top 5 cards of the encounter deck and check their game icons. You may mulligan once. If all 5 cards have a sequential rank, or if 3 or more of the cards have the same rank, gain 5 resources.

back_flavor: Roulette seems to be a favorite of many patrons and of the establishment itself. The casino is named after this icon of Monte Carlo gambling, after all.
flavor: Red or black, what tickles your fancy?
name: Roulette Wheel
text: [action] Spend 1 resource: Name a color and a rank. Then, discard the top card of the encounter deck and check its game icon. If it matches the named color and rank, gain 5 resources.

back_flavor: Baccarat has been popular among French nobility and aristocrats for over a century, perhaps longer. Even in this casino, this seems to remain true, with the most well-dressed and ostentatious sitting around the baccarat tables.
name: Baccarat Table
text: [action] Spend 2 resources: Name "player," "banker," or "tie." Discard the top 2 cards of the encounter deck and check their game icons. If the combined value of their ranks is higher than 18, the "player" wins. If the combined value is lower than 18, the "banker" wins. If the combined value is equal to 18, it is a "tie." If this result matches the result you named, gain 4 resources.

back_flavor: Several rows of machines stand to one side, hooking unwary souls into an endless cycle of spend and pull, spend and pull, spend and pull. No skill or finesse needed here - just raw submission to the whims of fortune.
flavor: "Jackpot!"
name: Slot Machines
text: [action] Spend 1 resource: Discard the top 3 cards of the encounter deck and check their game icons. If all 3 cards have the same suit or same rank, gain 3 resources.

name: High Roller's Table
text: [action] If there are no clues here, spend 4 resources: Remember that you "impersonated a high roller." Discard the top 5 cards of the encounter deck and check their game icons. You may mulligan once. If all 5 cards have the same suit or a sequential rank, or if 4 of the cards have the same rank, gain 8 resources.

name: High Roller's Table
text: [action] Spend 4 resources: Discard the top 5 cards of the encounter deck and check their game icons. You may mulligan once. If all 5 cards have the same suit or a sequential rank, or if 4 cards have the same rank, gain 8 resources and remember that you "won a cultist medallion."

flavor: The sumptuous lounge area boasts culinary delights, a stage suitable for all manner of entertainment, and countless tables for conducting business - both legal and illicit.
name: Casino Lounge
text: [action] If there are no clues on Casino Lounge: Test [agility] (3). If you succeed, remember that you "found a vent."

name: Casino Lounge
text: [action] If you "found a vent," investigators at Casino Lounge spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Move. Move to Guard Room. Then, reveal Staff Access Hallway if it has not already been revealed. Remember that "the vent is open." (Group limit once per game.) While "the vent is open," investigators may move from Casino Lounge to Guard Room as if they were connected, and vice versa.

back_flavor: The door to the restricted section of the casino beckons... but you must find a way through when no one is looking and the entrance is unguarded.
back_text: As an additional cost to enter Staff Access Hallway, investigators at a connecting location must spend 4 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.
flavor: "Is this the way to the bathroom?"
name: Staff Access Hallway
text: Forced - When Staff Access Hallway is revealed: Spawn Abarran Arrigorriagakoa (Abarran Unleashed) at Owner's Office. Shuffle the encounter discard pile and the set-aside Fortune's Chosen encounter set into the encounter deck.

back_flavor: A sign on the door reads "Security." You've heard from your sources that the staff has some means of monitoring the casino at all times. Perhaps whatever is behind this door provides the answer.
name: Security Office
text: [action]: Choose 1, 2, or 3. Discard that many cards from the top of the encounter deck and check their game icons. If an icon matches the rank of an enemy in play, remember that you "observed the staff." If the combined value of the discarded cards is 19 or higher, draw the top card in the encounter discard pile.

back_flavor: Through a crack in the door, you see a room filled with security uniforms and equipment.
name: Guard Room
text:
[action] If all of the following are true, remember that you "impersonated a guard:"
- There are no enemies at Guard Room.
- There are no clues remaining on Guard Room.
- An investigator "obtained an employee uniform."

back_flavor: The placard next to the door reads "Abarran Arrigorriagakoa." It's likely that important secrets and materials might be kept here... if only you could get in.
back_text: The Owner's Office is locked. As an additional cost to enter Owner's Office, investigators at a connecting location must spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, unless an investigator "stole Abarran's keys."
flavor: Abarran's safe and desk drawers are locked. The far side of the office peers into the main hall of the casino through a false wall.
name: Owner's Office
text:
X is equal to the highest alarm level among investigators at Owner's Office.
[action] If there are no clues on Owner's Office: Remember that you "found Abarran's sigil."

back_flavor: The clinking of chips and coins emanates through the doorway of this room. You're not really here for money, though… right?
name: Counting Room
text:
[action] Investigators at Counting Room spend 10 [per_investigator] resources, as a group (5 [per_investigator] instead if you "found a vent"): Remember that you "obtained a schematic."
[reaction] After you successfully investigate Counting Room by 2 or more: Gain 2 resources. (Limit once per turn.)

back_flavor: A massive steel door looms before you. Miniscule grooves run through it from top to bottom, seemingly acting as channels for the arcane energy that keeps it shut.
back_text: The door to the casino vault is locked, guarded, and warded with magic. You cannot enter Vault Door unless you have completed at least 4 of the tasks on The Heist story card.
name: Vault Door
text: [action] Move. Discard the top card of the encounter deck and check its game icon (if an investigator "obtained a schematic," you may mulligan up to two times): - Ifits suit is ♣ or ♠: Move to Guard Room. - If its suit is ♥: Move to Casino Lounge. - If its suit is ♦: Move to Baccarat Table.

back_text:
You cannot enter Relic Room.
Vault Door gains: "[action] Take 1 damage and 1 horror unless an investigator "found Abarran's sigil": Test [willpower] or [agility] (4). If you succeed, investigators at Vault Door may spend 4 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, to reveal Relic Room.
name: Relic Room
text: Forced - After Relic Room is revealed: Move all clues from The Wellspring of Fortune to Relic Room. [action] If there are no clues on Relic Room: Take control of The Wellspring of Fortune and attach it to your investigator card.

back_text: Each of the following is a task that can be completed in Fortune and Folly, Part II: □ An investigator "won a cultist medallion." □ An investigator "observed the staff." □ An investigator "found Abarran's sigil." □ An investigator "obtained a schematic." □ An investigator "impersonated a guard." □ An investigator "stayed out of sight." □ An investigator "delivered a decoy package." □ "Isamara mesmerized the guards with her song." Hint: You must complete at least 4 of these tasks to unlock the vault door.
name: The Stakeout
text:
Each of the following is a task that can be completed in Fortune and Folly, Part I: □ An investigator "found a vent." □ An investigator "impersonated a high roller." □ An investigator "convinced Isamara to participate in the heist." □ An investigator "obtained an employee uniform." □ An investigator "stole Abarran's keys." □ An investigator "cleaned out the house."
Forced - When an investigator is eliminated (by defeat or resignation): Place each of that investigator's clues on this story card, instead of placing them at their location.

back_text:
You pass the package to the employee.
The attached enemy's patrol location changes to Vault Door. Attached enemy loses the [[Casino]] trait. If attached enemy enters Vault Door, the package has been delivered (read the section below). If attached enemy leaves play, remove this story card from the game.
If the package has been delivered: Choose an investigator to search their deck for an [[Ally]] or [[Item]] asset and place it facedown beneath Vault Door. Remember that you "delivered a decoy package." Discard the attached enemy and attach this story card to Vault Door. [action]: Put the facedown asset beneath Vault Door into play under your control. Remove this story card from the game.
name: If the Uniform Fits…
text:
This casino employee looks like they are wearing a uniform in your size.
[action]: Fight. Perform this attack only on the attached enemy. Test [combat] (3). If you succeed, attached enemy has been knocked out (read the section below). If you fail, raise your alarm level by 1. If attached enemy leaves play, remove this story card from the game.
If attached enemy is knocked out: Remember that you "obtained an employee uniform." Raise your alarm level by 1 if another enemy is at your location or a connecting location. Discard the attached enemy. Remove this story card from the game.

back_text:
Just as you are about to act, there is a sudden pop and a spark, and the casino plunges into total darkness. There are panicked whispers from all around. This seems like an unfortunately timed malfunction of some kind. Now you must find your way forward in the dark unless you can find a way to restore the power.
Put this card into play next to the agenda deck. Place a damage token on each location. Each location with a damage token has no lights and gains: "This location gets +1 shroud. As an additional cost to trigger an ability on this location, you must either spend an additional action or take 1 horror." While an investigator is at Security Office, they may perform the following action: [action]: Spend 1 [per_investigator] clues. Choose one - - Restore power to the main hall. Remove a damage token from each [[Public]] location. - Restore power to the staff area. Remove a damage token from each [[Restricted]] location.
name: Fortune's Disfavor
text:
Isamara warned you that the relic you seek possesses strange abilities that bring misfortune upon those who are not favored by its bearer. Perhaps, then, you should have factored a sudden turn of fortune into your plans. For, at this moment, in the midst of your high-stakes heist, everything is about to be turned upside-down...
Flip this card over and resolve the text on its other side.

back_text:
What suddenly strikes the casino can only be described as a series of extremely unlikely and unfortunate mishaps. Glasses shatter, stray dice cause patrons to slip and fall, and chandeliers crash onto skulls.
Put this card into play next to the agenda deck. One at a time, each investigator discards the top card of the encounter deck and checks its game icon. The following injury applies to that investigator for the remainder of the game: - If its suit is ♥: You are limited to one move action per turn. - If its suit is ♦: You are limited to one investigate action per turn. - If its suit is ♣: You are limited to one fight action per turn. - If its suit is ♠: You are limited to one activate action per turn. text: Patrol (counterclockwise). Retaliate. Forced - When you would deal 1 or more damage to Fortune's Shield: Discard the top card of the encounter deck and check its game icon. If its suit is ♥, cancel 1 of that damage. ♠K

name: Fortune's Shield
text: Patrol (clockwise). Retaliate. Forced - When you would deal 1 or more damage to Fortune's Shield: Discard the top card of the encounter deck and check its game icon. If its suit is ♥, cancel 1 of that damage. ♥K

name: Fortune's Dagger
text: Patrol (counterclockwise). Retaliate. Forced - When Fortune's Dagger attacks you: Discard the top 2 cards of the encounter deck and check their game icons. For each card that has the ♣ suit, this attack deals +1 damage. ♣K

name: Fortune's Dagger
text: Patrol (clockwise). Retaliate. Forced - When Fortune's Dagger attacks you: Discard the top 2 cards of the encounter deck and check their game icons. For each card that has the ♣ suit, this attack deals +1 damage. ♦K

text: Hunter. Forced - After any investigator performs the same type of action twice in a row during the same phase, if Dimensional Shambler is ready and unengaged: Move it once toward that investigator. (Limit once per turn.) ♠A

Treat this card as an [[Extradimensional]] enemy with 1 fight, 1 health, 1 evade, 1 damage, and 1 horror. If that enemy disengages from you, discard it. ♠6

name: Dimensional Duplicator
text: Hunter. Forced - After you deal 1 or more damage to Dimensional Duplicator: Put the top card of your deck into play facedown, engaged with you. Treat this card as an [[Extradimensional]] enemy with 1 fight, 1 health, 1 evade, 1 damage, and 1 horror. If that enemy disengages from you, discard it. ♣6

name: Dimensional Displacer
text: Hunter. Retaliate. Spawn - Discard the nearest non-unique [[Casino]] enemy without an encounter card attached to it. Spawn Dimensional Displacer at that location. (If there are no such enemies in play, instead discard Dimensional Displacer and it gains surge.) ♦6

name: Dimensional Displacer
text: Hunter. Retaliate. Spawn - Discard the nearest non-unique [[Casino]] enemy without an encounter card attached to it. Spawn Dimensional Displacer at that location. (If there are no such enemies in play, instead discard Dimensional Displacer and it gains surge.) ♥6

name: Dimensional Hypnosis
text: Revelation - Attach to the nearest location without a copy of Dimensional Hypnosis attached. As an additional cost for you to leave attached location, test [willpower] (3). If you fail, cancel the effects of the move, move the nearest [[Extradimensional]] enemy once toward you, and discard Dimensional Hypnosis. ♠5

name: Dimensional Hypnosis

If you fail, cancel the effects of the move, move the nearest [[Extradimensional]] enemy once toward you, and discard Dimensional Hypnosis. ♣5

name: Dimensional Hypnosis
text: Revelation - Attach to the nearest location without a copy of Dimensional Hypnosis attached. As an additional cost for you to leave attached location, test [willpower] (3). If you fail, cancel the effects of the move, move the nearest [[Extradimensional]] enemy once toward you, and discard Dimensional Hypnosis. ♠4

name: Grip of the Beyond
text: Revelation - Put Grip of the Beyond into play in your threat area. Forced - At the end of your turn: Take 2 damage. Reduce this damage by 1 for each time you moved this turn. Discard Grip of the Beyond. ♦5

name: Grip of the Beyond
text: Revelation - Put Grip of the Beyond into play in your threat area. Forced - At the end of your turn: Take 2 damage. Reduce this damage by 1 for each time you moved this turn. Discard Grip of the Beyond. ♥5

name: Grip of the Beyond
text: Revelation - Put Grip of the Beyond into play in your threat area. Forced - At the end of your turn: Take 2 damage. Reduce this damage by 1 for each time you moved this turn. Discard Grip of the Beyond. ♦4

name: Hunter's Hunger
text: Peril. Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Discard an [[Ally]] asset you control. Each other investigator takes 1 horror. - Test [agility] (3). If you fail, take 1 direct damage and 1 direct horror. ♣4

name: Hunter's Hunger
text: Peril. Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Discard an [[Ally]] asset you control. Each other investigator takes 1 horror. - Test [agility] (3). If you fail, take 1 direct damage and 1 direct horror. ♥4

back_text:
Hard / Expert

Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the strength of the abyss.

[tablet]: 0. For this skill test, ignore all bonuses to your skill value.

back_flavor: You've found enough leads to confirm the existence of a shadowy organisation within Cairo, and perhaps the origin of the curse afflicting the city. However, despite your best efforts, the secret cabal has vanished from the city without a trace. You're going to need a lot more information if you are to cure this illness.
back_text: Find each [[Brotherhood]] enemy currently in play (at a location or in an investigator's threat area). Place each of those enemies beneath the scenario reference card, out of play. Shuffle each set-aside copy of Abyssal Revenant into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile. Add 1 strength to the abyss. If it is act 1, advance the current act.
flavor: Jessie Burke, a government agent who works in Egypt, has asked you to come to Cairo to help her solve a medical quandary. People all over Cairo, from all walks of life, are mysteriously falling into a wakeless slumber - including Jessie's husband and partner, John. It is up to you to get to the bottom of this strange phenomenon.
name: Jessie's Request
text: [action] Investigators spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Randomly spawn one of the enemies beneath the scenario reference card.

back_flavor: As more and more fall victim to the curse that has infected Cairo, a silent terror grips the city. When night falls again, the streets are filled with a sudden panic. It starts with turmoil outside the hospital, as people demand to know what has happened to their loved ones and what the doctors are doing to solve the problem. Before long, rioting and looting erupt throughout the city. By midnight, the streets have descended into utter chaos.
back_text:
Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
Add 1 strength to the abyss.
flavor: The sun rises over Cairo. Many more people within the city did not wake up this morning. A grim thought seizes your mind: Should you fall asleep, you too may never wake again. Having gotten little rest the previous night, you struggle to stay awake and continue your investigation…
name: Curse of the Abyss
text: Forced - If the strength of the abyss is 0: Set the strength of the abyss to 1. Each investigator draws 1 card and heals 1 horror.

back_flavor:
You are too exhausted to go on. Your mind screams at your body to keep moving, but your muscles have betrayed you. You sink to the ground like a sack of bricks.
You resist with all your strength, but all it amounts to is a wiggling of your fingers. You feel as thought a heavy weight is pressed upon your head, and a dark cloak is thrown over your eyes.
If you fall asleep here, you are sure you'll never wake again. And yet, somehow, deep within your mind, you're too tired to care.
You yawn.
back_text: Add 1 strength to the abyss. Each investigator who has not resigned is defeated and is "taken by the abyss."
flavor: When morning comes, the city is silent once more. The hospital is overflowing with last night's victims, and many more comatose people fill the streets. You've evaded sleep for this long, but you can't go on much longer. Fatigue has inflicted its toll on your body and mind. If you don't act fast, you may be the spell's next victim.
name: Garden of Shadows
text: Forced - If the strength of the abyss is 0 or 1: Set the strength of the abyss to 2. Each investigator either draws 1 card or heals 1 horror.

back_flavor: You corner one of the organization's agents in a dark alleyway as he attempts to flee the city. "It is too late to stop the prophecy," he says with a frightened expression. "Please, just let me go." Seeing weakness in the man's heart, you tell him that he can help you stop what the organization is plotting, if he tells you everything he knows. "The Brotherhood of the Beast believes they have found their vessel," he explains, stuttering nervously. "Now they're giving their Chosen untold power. There's no way you can stop them!" He struggles and breaks free from your grasp, fleeing back toward the main street. If you follow that man, perhaps he will lead you to the brotherhood's hideout…
back_text:
Create the exploration deck by shuffling together each of the set-aside [[Expedition]] locations. Search the encounter deck and discard pile for 1 copy each of the following treachery cards: Terror Under the Pyramids, Swarm of Locusts, Abyssal Reach, Eclipse, and Sandstorm. Shuffle those cards into the exploration deck, then shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck.
Each investigator loses each of his or her clues.
Remove all clues from each [[Cairo]] location.
flavor: As you scour Cairo for answers, you begin to suspect that Jessie's hunch was right. You're being tailed by shadowy figures throughout the city, and several of the people you interview want nothing to do with you. What are they hiding?
name: Curse of Endless Sleep
text: Forced - After a [[Brotherhood]] enemy enters the victory display: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side. Objective - Find as many [[Evidence]] cards as you can and add them to the victory display before the agenda advances. (If there are 6 [[Evidence]] cards in the victory display, advance.)

back_flavor:
You are unable to find the Brotherhood's hideout, but you are able to find the agent you interrogated in Cairo… Or at least, what remains of him. Inside the halls of an ancient temple dedicated to a long-forgotten pharaoh, the man's corpse has been placed upon a stone altar. His body is riddled with fresh stab wounds. You can't help but wonder if this was - in a way - your doing.
Investigating the body and the remainder of the half-buried temple yields a troubling discovery. As you suspected, the Brotherhood of the Beast is behind the curse afflicting Cairo. You find several passages describing the spell in greater detail - though these descriptions do not match what you have seen with your own eyes. The Brotherhood's tomes describe how to transport their victims to another realm, a place called the Abyss. A nightmarescape from which the dreamers cannot awaken. With each dreamer, their "Chosen" grows in strength…
back_text:
Place 1 [per_investigator] damage tokens on each [[Cairo]] location. Until the end of the scenario, damage tokens on locations represent "dreamers" - victims who have been cursed with eternal slumber.
Put the set-aside Neith enemy into play in the Streets of Cairo.
flavor: You pursue the Brotherhood's agent west as he flees the city. Following his trail into the desert will be easier if you join the archaeological expedition currently underway.
name: Secrets in the Sand
text: Clues cannot be placed on [[Cairo]] locations. [action] If you are at an [[Expedition]] location: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it.

back_flavor: With each of the dreamers you set free, the arcane power wielded by Neith fades. Before long, she has collapsed to her knees, the power completely drained from her body. However, even with the spells and records you found in the Brotherhood's temple, you're unable to awaken all of the victims; only those most recently put under the spell's sway. As for the remainder of the victims - including John Burke - their fate is inextricably tied to Neith. "If you believe that this is the end, you deserve the fate Xzharah has in store for you," she warns you. "Slay me and you will be next in line to die." You waver. But if she is allowed to live, those she has ensnared in sleep will never awaken. What is one life, compared to the lives of so many innocents?
back_text:
The investigators must decide (choose wisely): -Destroy Neith once and for all.
By choosing this option, you believe those still under the curse of eternal slumber will be freed. (→R1) - Spare Neith and listen to what she has to say.
By choosing this option, you believe you can learn more about the one Neith refers to as Xzharah. (→R2)
flavor: The final record you find describes a time of reaping, wherein a thousand dreamers will be sacrificed. Armed with the Brotherhood's knowledge, you believe you can reverse their curse before they claim the waking lives of every last man, woman, and child in Cairo.
name: The Hour of Judgment
text: [action] If there is a dreamer at your location: Test [willpower] or [intellect] (X) to attempt to awaken a dreamer. X is the strength of the abyss. If you succeed, move a dreamer from your location to Neith, as damage. Objective - If Neith has no remaining health, advance.

back_flavor: It is an unusually dry month in Cairo. The narrow, winding streets of the city are baked by the hot, unrelenting sun. Pedestrians travel from shadow to shadow to keep out of the sunlight… Or are they avoiding you?
name: Streets of Cairo
text: Forced - After you discover 2 or more clues at Streets of Cairo during a single turn: Take 1 horror. [action] If there are no clues on Streets of Cairo: Test [agility] (4). If you succeed, remember that you have "found a door marked with blood."

back_flavor: The busy streets of the bazaar are packed with peddlers hawking their wares and a raucous throng of patrons. Navigating your way through the crowd is difficult enough - finding your mark will be even more troublesome.
name: Cairo Bazaar
text:
While you are at Cairo Bazaar, reduce the cost of each [[Item]] asset you play by 1 and increase the cost of each other asset you play by 1.
[action] Spend 10 resources: Remember that you "bought an odd trinket."

back_flavor: This new museum - built in Tahrir Square after the Nile flooded the previous building - houses the world's largest collection of Pharaonic antiquities, including papyrus, coins, statues, tablets, coffins, and even mummies.
name: Museum of Egyptian Antiquities
text: [action]: Test [intellect] (5). If you succeed, remember that you have "discovered an ancient tablet." Forced - After you investigate Museum of Egyptian Antiquities, if you did not succeed by at least 2: Lose all remaining actions and immediately end your turn.

back_flavor: As the hot sun sets over Cairo, the sky is bathed in beautiful rays of orange and red. It is a magnificent prelude to the horrors to come.
name: Outskirts of Cairo
text: [action] Choose and discard 5 cards from your hand: Remember that you have "sabotaged the train." [action] If no investigator has "sabotaged the train": Resign. You take the train out of Cairo, leaving the dreamers to their unceasing nightmare.

back_flavor: Silvery rays of light gently bathe the courtyard in a soft glow. Despite the urgency of your task, you feel at peace here. You vow to return if you're still awake when this is over.
name: Temple Courtyard
text:
While there are no clues remaining on Temple Courtyard, each copy of Humble Supplicant loses aloof.
[action]: Test [combat] (5). If you succeed, remember that you have "broken into a deserted temple."

name: Neith
text: Hunter. Retaliate Forced - After horror from Neith's attack defeats an investigator or [[Ally]] asset: That card is "taken by the abyss." Forced - When Neith is dealt any amount of damage from an attack, if there is at least 1 dreamer at her location: Remove 1 dreamer from her location and cancel 1 damage just dealt to Neith.

name: Humble Supplicant
text: Spawn - Any [[Cairo]] location (with a [[Brotherhood]] enemy, if able). Aloof. Each [[Brotherhood]] enemy at Humble Supplicant's location cannot be attacked or damaged. Forced - When the enemy phase ends: Move Humble Supplicant once toward the nearest [[Brotherhood]] enemy, if able.

name: Creature from the Abyss
text: Retaliate. X is the strength of the abyss. Forced - After Creature from the Abyss enters play, if the strength of the abyss is 2 or lower: Add 1 strength to the abyss. Forced - After Creature from the Abyss is defeated, if the strength of the abyss is 5 or higher: Remove 1 strength from the abyss.

Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is 1 more than the strength of the abyss.
[cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail and the strength of the abyss is 5 or lower, add 1 strength to the abyss.
[tablet]: -3. For this skill test, ignore all bonuses to your skill value.
[elder_thing]: -5. If you succeed and the strength of the abyss is 4 or more, remove 1 strength from the abyss.
name: The Night's Usurper
text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the strength of the abyss.
[cultist]: Reveal another token. If you fail and the strength of the abyss is 3 or lower, add 1 strength to the abyss.
[tablet]: -1. For this skill test, ignore all bonuses to your skill value.
[elder_thing]: -4. If you succeed and the strength of the abyss is 4 or more, remove 1 strength from the abyss.

back_flavor: Having found the perfect moment to strike, the remaining members of the Brotherhood ambush you in the night. "For Nephren-Ka! For Xzharah!" they cry out in exultation as they surround your camp. Their eyes are burning red with unnatural power, their muscles bulging and their veins pulsing with bizarre fluid. Nothing you say deters their attack, and you wonder if there is any humanity left in their minds at all.
back_text: In player order, each investigator takes a random [[Brotherhood]] enemy from under the scenario reference card and spawns it engaged with him or her, until either each of the enemies under the scenario reference card have been spawned, or each investigator has spawned an enemy in this way. Spawn each enemy still remaining under the scenario reference card, one at a time, at empty locations farthest from the Expedition Camp. (Ignore all "Spawn" instructions on those enemies.) Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. Add 1 strength to the abyss.
flavor: With members of the Brotherhood still at large, your research had to be done in secret, away from prying eyes. Now that you are exposed, you know that anyone could be a spy for the secret cabal - even members of Winlock's expedition. It is a risk you must take in order to stop their plot. Regardless, knowing they could strike at any moment sets your nerves on edge. Sooner or later, they will show their hand, and you will have to be ready.
name: The Brotherhood Bides Their Time

back_flavor:
"It is done." Xzharah plunges his blade into the last of the dreamers. Its starry surface, soaked in hot crimson blood, devours the victim's life force. "With this soul, I am complete."
The abyss is plunged into a dreadful silence. None can question the authority and power of the realm's new lord. Uncouth creatures of darkness crawl forth from their pits to pay tribute to their master. As Xzharah surveys his domain, the mist coils about his feet with each step he takes. Countless winged creatures bow in servitude as he passes.
This world is his. Ours is next.
back_text: Each investigator is defeated. Each defeated investigator is "taken by the abyss." (→R1)
flavor: This sinister plot threatens not only our own world, but another. You have only one chance to stop them from achieving their goal. Now is the time for action.
name: Schemes in the Dark Beyond
text: Investigators cannot Parley with [[Brotherhood]] enemies. Each [[Brotherhood]] enemy cannot be flipped over. Forced - After the 4th or 8th doom is placed on this agenda: Add 1 strength to the abyss.

back_flavor:
It has been several weeks since you set forth from Cairo, but to your dismay, you have found no sign of the otherworldly gate to which the Brotherhood supposedly retreated. Just as you are considering returning to Cairo to conduct more research, you are summoned into Winlock's tent, where the weary expedition leader is examining a map of Egypt with calloused hands. "Oh good, you're here," he says, fumbling through his pack for an old, half-burned tome, which he places on the table in front of you. "Thought you might want to see what we found in that crypt to the south." You turn over the book, sifting through its charred pages, until you come to a map of the desert marked by Egyptian hieroglyphs. It is the same region depicted on the map in front of Winlock. "See that, right there?" He points to one of the hieroglyphs on the western side of the map. "It means 'door'." With a hint of a smirk, he then points to the same spot on his larger map, marking your destination.
"That what you're looking for?"
back_text: Shuffle the set-aside Eldritch Gate into the exploration deck.
flavor: With Winlock's support, the expedition is underway. But unlike the other archaeologists and researchers, you're not searching for ancient crypts or artifacts. You are after something older and far more dangerous: a place the others would not believe existed even if you told them.
name: Search for the Gate
text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it.

back_flavor: Reality slips away as you cross the threshold of the gate. The sandy dunes fold into the foundation of the Earth, the firmament splits, and the colors of the world bleed into the archway. When next you open your eyes, you are in a place between worlds. At the opposite end of the corridor, a figure emerges from the doorway beyond, faceless and wielding a curved blade that pulses with dark power. "You shall be my next sacrifice," his voice seethes.
back_text:
Put the set-aside A Dream Betwixt location into play, revealed location side faceup. Move each investigator there and remove all other locations from the game. Spawn the set-aside Xzharah enemy in A Dream Betwixt, enemy side faceup. Shuffle each set-aside copy of Dreaded Shantak into the encounter deck, along with the encounter discard pile.
If the Ancient Ankh asset is in play:
Your Ankh amulet glows with a blinding light, causing Xzharah to recoil. "So, Neith has abandoned us!" Xzharah hisses.
Exhaust Xzharah and disengage him from all investigators.
flavor: Having sufficiently narrowed down the location of the gateway, you part ways with Winlock and his team. You don't want them following where you're going…
name: Into the Gate
text: [action]: Explore. Draw the top card of the exploration deck. If it is a connecting location, put it into play and move to it. Objective - At the end of the round, if each undefeated investigator is at the Eldritch Gate and they spend the requisite number of clues, advance.

back_flavor: Xzharah cannot be stopped by means you alone possess. Perhaps if you learn more about the realm beyond the gateway, you can find a way to end this vile ritual.
back_text: If at least three of the following requirements are met, you may proceed to (→R2). Otherwise, flip this act back to its "a" side. - Xzharah must have no remaining health. - Investigators must possess 3 [per_investigator] clues, as a group. - The strength of the abyss must be 4 or lower. - The investigators must have "freed the nightgaunts," "warned the denizens of Sarkomand," and "pled for help."
flavor: Xzharah is gathering his strength, slaying each and every dreamer who crosses between this realm and the Abyss beyond. When the last soul is his, who will be left to prevent his conquest?
name: The Night's Usurper
text: Objective - "We have to find a way to stop him!" If Xzharah is exhausted, an investigator at his location may choose to advance. (Limit once per phase.)

name: A Dream Betwixt
text: Forced - If the strength of the abyss is 0: Set the strength of the abyss to 1. [reaction] After you successfully investigate A Dream Betwixt: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.

flavor:
The gateway beyond this corridor leads to a place beyond the physical world. A place where dreams and reality converge.
You steady your thoughts and stare into the abyss. The abyss embraces you.
name: To the Dreamlands
text: Put each of the remaining set-aside locations into play, revealed location side faceup - The Great Abyss, Tunnels under Ngranek, Stairway to Sarkomand, and Mist-Filled Caverns. (Place clues on each of those locations equal to their clue value.) The investigator resolving this text disengages from each engaged enemy and moves to The Great Abyss. Flip this card back over. For the remainder of the game, it cannot be flipped over again.

flavor: …he had indeed reached the yawning gulf whose crusted and mouldy stone steps lead down to the crypts of nightmare. - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
name: The Great Abyss
text: [reaction] After you discover the last remaining clue from The Great Abyss: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.

flavor: As you traverse the vast abyss, you are surprised to find others wandering through the cavernous mist, mesmerized and confused. You don't recognize them as patients from the incident in Cairo. The Brotherhood must have sent these victims here recently. With the knowledge you have now, you could try to awaken them - or guide them to Xzharah as sacrifices.
name: Fate of the Dreamers
text:
You must decide (choose one):
- Remove 2 strength from the abyss.
- Add 2 strength to the abyss.
Regardless of your choice, flip this card back over. For the remainder of the game, it cannot be flipped over again.

flavor: …Ngranek is very difficult and barren and sinister, and there are rumours of caves near the peak wherein dwell the night-gaunts. - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
name: Tunnels under Ngranek
text: [action]: Test [intellect] (2) to search for signs of life within these jagged tunnels. If you succeed, flip this location over and resolve the text on its other side.

flavor: As you explore the volcanic tunnels, you find brutalized corpses of dozens of winged creatures: some black and faceless, with membranous wings and dark horns; others huge and scaly, with bat-like wings and heads like a horse's. Continuing deeper down the tunnels, you come across more of the faceless creatures restrained by thick iron chains. Prisoners of Xzharah, you imagine. They make no sound as you approach, their uncanny heads turning towards you.
name: Prisoners of Conquest
text:
You must decide (choose one):
- Test [agility] (4) to free the creatures. If you succeed, one of them hands you 3 black whistles before they fly off toward their master; take control of the set-aside Summoned Nightgaunt asset and remember that you "freed the nightgaunts."
- Test [combat] (4) to slay the creatures. If you succeed, remember that you "executed the nightgaunts."
Regardless of your choice and whether you succeed or fail the indicated skill test, flip this card back over.

flavor: Terrible is the memory of that dark descent in which hours wore themselves away whilst Carter wound sightlessly round and round down a fathomless spiral of steep and slippery stairs. - H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
name: Stairway to Sarkomand
text: [action]: Test [willpower] (3) to navigate the bewildering and gravity-defying staircase. If you succeed, flip this location over and resolve the text on its other side.

flavor: After what feels like an eternity, you finally reach the top of the subterranean stairs, where a trapdoor leads you to the surface. You find yourself in the large central plaza of a ruined city on the shoreline of a beautiful sky-blue ocean. A pair of colossal winged lion statues guards the entrance to the stairway.
name: Ruins of Sarkomand
text:
You must decide (choose one):
- Test [intellect] (3) to speak to the almost-humanoid creatures that dwell in these ruins. If you succeed, you warn them of the battle below and they flee; remember that you "warned the denizens of Sarkomand."
- Test [combat] (3) to block the trapdoor. If you succeed, you topple the lion statues and use them to block the entrance to the stairway as you descend back into the depths; remember that you "cut off all escape."
Regardless of your choice and whether you succeed or fail the indicated skill test, flip this card back over.

name: Mist-Filled Caverns
text: [action]: Test [agility] (4) to traverse through the mist. If you succeed, flip this location over and resolve the text on its other side.

flavor: The mist grows ever thicker as you make your way deeper into the depths of the abyss. Finally, you come across an open chamber where the mist has receded, and you are greeted by a tall statue of an elderly man with a great bear and a mane of long hair. He rides a chariot formed from a huge seashell, which is pulled by beasts both wondrous and strange.
name: Effigy of Nodens
text:
You must decide (choose one):
- Test [willpower] (2) to entreat the entity depicted in this statue for aid. If you succeed, remember that you "pled for help."
- Test [combat] (2) to overthrow the statue. If you succeed, it topples over and shatters into pieces on the jagged cavern floor; remember that you "affronted the ruler of this realm."
Regardless of your choice and whether you succeed or fail the indicated skill test, flip this card back over.

name: Xzharah
text: Hunter. Retaliate Xzharah gets +5 [per_investigator] health and cannot be defeated by damage. [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] or [intellect] (X), where X is the strength of the abyss. If you succeed, flip this enemy over and resolve the text on its other side. If you fail, Xzharah attacks you.

flavor: The Chosen One's words are grim whispers that worm their way into your ears. "The Day of Nephren-Ka shall come, and the road shall be paved with blood," he promises. "Prove your loyalty and you shall be rewarded. When the Day arrives, you alone shall be spared. Refuse, and be consumed. Then I alone shall rule this place."
name: Usurp the Night
text: If each of the following requirements are met, you may proceed to (→R3). - The strength of the abyss must be 5 or higher. - The investigators must have "executed the nightgaunts," "cut off all escape," and "affronted the ruler of this realm." If the above requirements are not met, each investigator may choose whether or not to accept Xzharah's mercy and immediately resign. If any investigators remain, flip this card back to its enemy side.

flavor: The colossal archway looms before you, appearing like something out of fiction. It doesn't take an archaeologist to realize it isn't Egyptian in origin. If this gateway truly leads somewhere else, there must be a way to "activate" it…
name: Eldritch Gate

flavor:
They were not any birds or bats known elsewhere on earth or in dreamland, for they were larger than elephants…
- H. P. Lovecraft, <u>The Dream-Quest of Unknown Kadath</u>
name: Dreaded Shantak
text:
Hunter. Massive.
While Dreaded Shantak is ready, [action] and [reaction] abilities on its location cannot be triggered.

name: Speaker for the Dark Pharaoh
text: While the strength of the abyss is 2 or lower, Speaker for the Dark Pharaoh gains hunter. Forced - After Speaker for the Dark Pharaoh is defeated, if the strength of the abyss is 3 or higher: Each investigator at its location takes 1 damage.

name: Dr. Layla El Masri
text: Spawn - Expedition Camp. [action] As a group, investigators at Dr. Layla El Masri's location discard cards from hand with a total of at least 4 [willpower] icons among them: Parley. Add Dr. Layla El Masri to the victory display.

flavor: "I didn't have a choice!" Layla cries. "The things I've read… The records I've translated… They all point to one thing," she claims. "Destruction. Ruin. We can't stop it. All we can do is forge a place for our loved ones in the rubble." You tell her that you will do everything in your power to stop this 'destruction', but she shakes her head, tears in her eyes. "It's a fool's errand. But… " Layla takes a deep breath as she considers her options. "Promise you'll keep my daughter and my son safe, and I'll help you in any way I can."
name: The Translator's Evidence
text:
After an investigator has "discovered an ancient tablet," read the following (if this task has already been completed, read the following immediately):
You bring the tablet to Dr. El Masri, and she translates it to the best of her ability. "When the Choice is made, He shall be empowered by a thousand sacrifices from the sacred land." She blinks a few times, trying to process what it means. "How many coma patients are there right now?" she asks, wide-eyed.
Remove 1 strength from the abyss. (Group limit once per game.)

name: Dr. Wentworth Moore
text: Spawn - Museum of Egyptian Antiquities. Dr. Wentworth Moore cannot be damaged while there is a ready [[Monster]] enemy at his location. Forced - After Dr. Wentworth Moore enters play: Search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Monster]] enemy, and spawn it at his location. Shuffle the encounter deck.

flavor: Despite your best efforts, Dr. Moore slips away while you are occupied by his 'bodyguard'. With the creature defeated, and you hot on his trail, you suspect he will try to escape the city while he has the chance.
name: The Supplicant's Evidence
text:
After an investigator has "sabotaged the train," read the following (if this task has already been completed, read the following immediately):
You manage to corner Dr. Moore as he tries to escape the city on foot. "Very clever," he admits. "But you're already out of time. Lock me up, it doesn't matter. The dreamers will be sacrificed, and our Chosen will lead us to a new age." But after several hours, he is begging to be let out of the city. "Please, the reaper is coming! Neith is coming for us all. We'll all be sacrificed, don't you understand? You and me both! All of us need to flee the city while we still can!"
Remove 1 strength from the abyss. (Group limit once per game.)

name: Nadia Nimr
text: Spawn - Temple Courtyard. [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] (7). You may take up to 3 horror to reduce the difficulty of this test by 2 for each horror taken in this way. If you succeed, add Nadia Nimr to the victory display. If you fail, Nadia Nimr attacks you.

flavor: Nadia's faith is shaken. Scared and confused, she finally gives in. "There is only one residence in Cairo they told us to spare," she explains. "None of us know why, or what their connection is to the Brotherhood. All we know is they were not to be disturbed." She hesitantly gives you a small brass key. "… So maybe it's time to disturb them. The building's door is marked with lamb's blood."
name: The Priestess's Evidence
text:
After an investigator has "found a door marked with blood," read the following (if this task has already been completed, read the following immediately):
Using the key Nadia gave you, you enter the marked residence. To your surprise, there is nobody inside - only the faint stench of rot and aged leather. The basement of the residence is littered with old books, records kept by the Brotherhood and its many agents. They will take some time to peruse, but a lead is a lead.
Remove 1 strength from the abyss. (Group limit once per game.)

name: Farid
text: Spawn - Cairo Bazaar. [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (7). You may spend up to 5 resources to reduce the difficulty of this test by 1 for each resource spent in this way. If you succeed, add Farid to the victory display. If you fail, Farid attacks you.

flavor: "All right, all right," Farid relents, " I'm a businessman, not a soldier. Strike a deal with me, and I'll tell you what I know. Then I'll skip out of town and be out of your hair." You ask what he wants. "There's a vault in the abandoned temple to the east. Word is, there are a lot of old, valuable artifacts in there. The kind that would fetch a high price on the black market." He grins toothily. "Get me into that temple, and I'm all yours. Deal?"
name: The Salesman's Evidence
text:
After an investigator has "broken into a deserted temple," read the following (if this task has already been completed, read the following immediately):
Farid grins wide as he scoops golden idols into his rucksack. You press him for information before he gets too excited. "Look, they promised me wealth beyond my wildest dreams. Even I have my price, you know?" He throws up his hands, resigned. "Let me show you my records. I've done a lot of 'business' in the last few months. That'll point you in the right direction."
Remove 1 strength from the abyss. (Group limit once per game.)

name: Nassor
text: Spawn - Streets of Cairo. Retaliate. Forced - When Nassor attacks: Either add 1 strength to the abyss, or Nassor deals +1 damage and +1 horror for this attack (+2 damage and +2 horror instead if it is the enemy phase).

flavor:
Despite his mortal wounds, the assassin grins wickedly. "The Day is coming," he says between a fit of coughs. "You think killing me will stop it? Fools! The Beast will devour you all!" He cackles with his final breath, then falls silent.
You are quick to search his belongings before any bystanders spot the body. Among the many strange curios on his person, you find a small leather-bound journal with a cryptic inscription:
Our tribute soaks the abyssal blade
A thousand souls never to wake
With this our Chosen shall arise
And the day is ever nigh!
name: The Assassin's Evidence
text: Remove 1 strength from the abyss. (Group limit once per game.)

name: Professor Nathaniel Taylor
text: Spawn - Outskirts of Cairo. [action] As a group, investigators at Professor Nathaniel Taylor's location discard cards from hand with a total of at least 4 [intellect] icons among them: Parley. Add Professor Nathaniel Taylor to the victory display.

flavor: "I'll be dead soon anyway," Professor Taylor admits with a deep sigh. "If it's not you, or the Brotherhood, it'll be the tumor in my lung." He dumps the ashes in his pipe and sets it on his table before turning back towards you. "Fine. I'm certain it'll be the death of both of us, but I'll help you out. Don't know what you expect of me, exactly. I suppose if you found one of the Brotherhood's artifacts, I could study it for you."
name: The Professor's Evidence
text:
After an investigator has "bought an odd trinket," read the following (if this task has already been completed, read the following immediately):
You set the trinket down on the professor's desk. He puts on his monocle and examines it carefully. "Intriguing!" he exclaims. "This could only have come from a particular tomb in the royal crypts. Most scholars don't believe it exists." He rises to his feet and shakes your hand. "Give me some time to study this further. Perhaps if we both make it out of this alive, I can resubmit my thesis," he says with a morbid chuckle.
Remove 1 strength from the abyss. (Group limit once per game.)

back_flavor: Just outside of the city, the greatest archaeological minds of the age are gathered together with the funding, resources, and knowledge to discover all of the secrets ancient Egypt has to hide. Perhaps their expedition will reveal the truths you are searching for.
name: Expedition Camp
text: [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (2) to speak to the researchers stationed here. If you succeed, look at the top X cards of either the exploration deck or the encounter deck, where X is the amount you succeeded by. Place up to 2 of those cards on the bottom of that deck. Place the rest on top in a random order. (Group limit once per round.)

name: Nile River
text: Forced - After you enter Nile River: You must either take 1 horror or discard 1 card from your hand at random.

name: Sands of Dashur
text: As an additional cost for you to explore while at Sands of Dashur, you must spend 2 resources.

name: Dunes of the Sahara
text: Forced - After you enter Dunes of the Sahara: You must either take 1 damage or lose 1 action.

name: Untouched Vault
text:
Each [[Monster]] enemy at Untouched Vault gets +2 fight and +1 damage value.
[action] If a [[Monster]] enemy was defeated here this round: You stare into the creature's dead eyes, and the abyss stares back at you. Remove 1 strength from the abyss. (Group limit once per game.)

name: Faceless Sphinx
text:
X is the strength of the abyss.
[action] If you have at least 2 clues: You stare into the sphinx's empty face, and the abyss stares back at you. Place 2 of your clues on Faceless Sphinx and remove 1 strength from the abyss. (Group limit once per game.)

name: Desert Oasis
text:
[action]: Heal 1 damage and 1 horror. (Limit once per game.)
[action][action] If you have no horror on you: You stare into the reflection on the water, and the abyss stares back at you. Take 3 horror and remove 1 strength from the abyss. (Group limit once per game.)

name: Sandswept Ruins
text:
While you are investigating Sandswept Ruins, if you have 5 or more cards in your hand, it gets +3 shroud.
[action][action] If you have 8 or more cards in your hand: You stare into the swirling sands, and the abyss stares back at you. Discard 3 cards from your hand at random and remove 1 strength from the abyss. (Group limit once per game.)

name: Abyssal Revenant
text: Spawn - Farthest [[Desert]] or [[Otherworld]] location. Hunter. Forced - When Abyssal Revenant attacks during the enemy phase: Instead of its standard damage, it deals X damage for this attack, where X is the strength of the abyss. If this attack defeats an investigator or [[Ally]] asset, that card is "taken by the abyss."

name: Thing in the Sarcophagus
text: Spawn - The location with the most clues. While its location has no clues, Thing in the Sarcophagus gains hunter. Forced - While Thing in the Sarcophagus is ready, when you attack it by any means except a [[Ranged]], [[Firearm]], or [[Spell]] card: It immediately attacks you.

name: Eclipse
text: While you are at an [[Otherworld]] location, Eclipse gains peril. Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). If you fail, you must either take 2 horror or choose an [[Ally]] asset at your location to be defeated and "taken by the abyss."

name: Sandstorm
text: While you are at an [[Desert]] location, Sandstorm gains peril. Revelation - Test [agility] (3). If you fail, you must either take 2 damage or discard an asset you control.

name: Terror Under the Pyramids
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each point you fail by, choose and discard 1 card from your hand. For each card you cannot discard, take 1 horror.

name: Swarm of Locusts
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). For each point you fail by, lose 1 resource. For each resource you cannot lose, take 1 damage.

name: Slumber
text: Revelation - Put Slumber into play in your threat area if there is no copy of it in your threat area (if there is, discard Slumber and it gains surge instead). Forced - When your turn begins: Test [willpower] (2). If you fail, lose 1 action. [reaction] After strength is removed from the abyss: Discard Slumber.

name: Dark Sacrifice
text: Revelation - Put Dark Sacrifice into play in your threat area if there is no copy of it in your threat area (if there is, discard Dark Sacrifice and it gains surge instead). Forced - After strength is added to the abyss: Take 1 damage and 1 horror. If this effect defeats an [[Ally]] asset or investigator, that card is "taken by the abyss." [reaction] After strength is removed from the abyss: Discard Dark Sacrifice.

name: The Black Wind
text: Peril. Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Add 1 strength to the abyss and add The Black Wind to the victory display. - Discard The Black Wind and draw the top card of the encounter deck to replace it. You get -1 to all skills for the remainder of this round.

name: Abyssal Reach
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (X). X is the strength of the abyss. If you fail by: - exactly 1, place 1 of your clues on your location. - exactly 2, take 1 damage and 1 horror. - exactly 3, you cannot play cards this round. - 4 or more, place 1 doom on the current agenda (this effect may cause the current agenda to advance).

flavor: Dead or alive… but mostly dead.
name: John & Jessie Burke
text: [action] Exhaust John & Jessie Burke and deal them 1 damage: Choose an enemy in a connecting location. Move to that enemy's location. Then, engage that enemy and deal it 1 damage.

name: Ancient Ankh
text:
Uses (4 charges).
[reaction] When an investigator at your location would fail a test by more than 1, spend 1 charge: That investigator fails by 1, instead (even if he or she automatically failed).

name: Khopesh of the Abyss
text: [action]: Fight. You get +3 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack. [reaction] After you defeat an enemy using Khopesh of the Abyss, exhaust it: Choose an enemy at another revealed location. Disengage from each other enemy engaged with you and move to the chosen enemy's location. Then, engage that enemy.

name: Summoned Nightgaunt
text: Uses (3 whistles). If Summoned Nightgaunt has no whistles, or if it leaves play, remove it from the game. [action] Spend 1 whistle and take 1 horror: Evade. Automatically evade all non-[[Nightgaunt]] enemies engaged with you and move to any revealed location.

back_flavor: Professor Walters began as a devotee of the archaic and obscure, but over the years he has discovered that his knowledge of ancient languages, profane relics, and strange rituals is vital to addressing dangers in the modern day. He is both an avid collector of prehistoric ephemera and a fount of knowledge regarding the bizarre primordial religions that worshipped nightmarish gods eons ago. There is perhaps no sane person alive who knows more about the occult than Harvey. When a supernatural event occurs, Professor Walters brings his considerable resources and experience to bear.
back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Vault of Knowledge, Thrice-Damned Curiosity, 1 random basic weakness.
flavor: "I have experience dealing with these sorts of horrors."
name: Harvey Walters
text:
[reaction] After an investigator at your location draws 1 or more cards from their deck during the investigation phase: That investigator draws 1 card. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +1. Draw 1 card.

name: Vault of Knowledge
text:
Harvey Walters deck only.
Your maximum hand size is increased by 2.
[reaction] After you successfully investigate, exhaust Vault of Knowledge and choose an investigator at your location: That investigator draws 1 card.

flavor:
"... I can only hope that my account will not arouse a curiosity greater than sane caution on the part of those who believe me at all."
- H. P. Lovecraft, "At the Mountains of Madness"
name: Thrice-Damned Curiosity
text: Revelation - For every 3 cards in your hand: Take 1 damage.

name: Obsessive
text: Revelation - Put Obsessive into play in your threat area. Forced - When your turn begins: Discard 1 non-weakness card at random from your hand. [action][action]: Discard Obsessive.

flavor: An augmented mind can memorize entire volumes of books.
name: Arcane Enlightenment
text:
Your maximum hand size is increased by 1.
You have 1 additional hand slot, which can only be used to hold a [[Tome]] asset.

name: Celaeno Fragments
text:
While you have...
- ...5 or more cards in hand, you get +1 [intellect].
- ...10 or more cards in hand, you get +1 [willpower].
- ...15 or more cards in hand, you get +1 [intellect].

flavor: Do they fear it because of what it will do to them? Or, do they fear it because of what it will do to you?
name: Disc of Itzamna
text: [reaction] When a non-[[Elite]] enemy spawns at your location, discard Disc of Itzamna: Automatically evade that enemy or deal it 2 damage.

name: Encyclopedia
text:
Uses (5 secrets).
[action] Exhaust Encyclopedia and spend 1 secret: Choose an investigator at your location. That investigator gets +2 to a skill of your choice until the end of the phase.

name: Feed the Mind
text:
Uses (3 secrets).
[action] Exhaust Feed the Mind and spend 1 secret: Test [intellect] (1). For each point you succeed by (to a maximum of 3), draw 1 card.

name: Forbidden Tome
text:
Uses (5 secrets).
[action] Exhaust Forbidden Tome and spend 1 secret: Draw 1 card. Then, if you have 10 or more cards in your hand and there are no secrets on Forbidden Tome, you may discard it to record in your Campaign Log that "you have translated the tome."

name: Higher Education
text:
While you have 5 or more cards in your hand, Higher Education gains:
"[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [willpower] for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [intellect] for this skill test."

name: Laboratory Assistant
text:
Your maximum hand size is increased by 2.
[reaction] After Laboratory Assistant enters play: Draw 2 cards.

name: Whitton Greene
text:
While you control a [[Tome]] or [[Relic]] asset, you get +1 [intellect].
[reaction] After you reveal a location or put a new location into play, exhaust Whitton Greene: Search the top 6 cards of your deck for a [[Tome]] or [[Relic]] asset and draw it. Shuffle your deck.

flavor: You'll sleep when you're dead.
name: Burning the Midnight Oil
text: Investigate. When this action begins, gain 2 resources.

flavor: "...these are few as compared with those in languages I cannot understand." - H. P. Lovecraft, "The Statement of Randolph Carter"
name: Cryptic Writings
text:
Gain 2 resources.
[reaction] After you draw Cryptic Writings during your turn: Play it.

flavor:
"Nothing in here, either. How many do we have left?"
"...See the wall behind you?"
name: Extensive Research
text:
Reduce the cost to play Extensive Research by 1 for each other card in your hand.
Discover 2 clues at your location.

name: Occult Invocation
text: As an additional cost to play Occult Invocation, discard up to 2 cards from your hand. Fight. This attack uses [intellect] instead of [combat]. You get +1 [intellect] and deal +1 damage for this attack for each card discarded as part of this card's cost.

name: Preposterous Sketches
text:
Play only if there is a clue on your location.
Draw 3 cards.

flavor: I knew I had seen this symbol before. I must warn the others before it is too late!
name: Deduction
text: If this skill test is successful while investigating a location, discover 1 additional clue at that location.

name: Library Docent
text: [reaction] After Library Docent enters play, return a [[Tome]] asset you control to its owner's hand: Play a different [[Tome]] asset (by title) from your hand, reducing its cost by 2.

flavor: Ignorance is a bliss you cannot afford.
name: Glimpse the Unthinkable
text: Draw 1 card. Shuffle any number of non-weakness cards from your hand into your deck. Then, draw that many cards.

name: Esoteric Atlas
text:
Uses (4 secrets).
[action] Spend 1 secret: Choose a revealed location up to 3 connections away from your location. Move to that location.

name: Whitton Greene
text:
While you control a [[Tome]] or [[Relic]] asset, you get +1 [willpower] and +1 [intellect].
[reaction] After you reveal a location or put a new location into play, exhaust Whitton Greene: Search the top 9 cards of your deck for a [[Tome]] or [[Relic]] asset and draw it. Shuffle your deck.

flavor: "...these are few as compared with those in the languages I cannot understand." - H. P. Lovecraft, "The Statement of Randolph Carter"
name: Cryptic Writings
text:
Gain 3 resources (4 resources instead if you have 10 or more other cards in hand).
[reaction] After you draw Cryptic Writings during your turn: Play it.

flavor: "That's the worst plan I've ever heard. Well, what are we waiting for?"
name: "I've got a plan!"
text: Fight. This attack uses [intellect] instead of [combat]. You get +2 [intellect] for this test. You deal +1 damage for this attack for each clue you have (max +3 damage).

name: Mind over Matter
text:
Fast. Play during your turn.
Until the end of the round, add your [intellect] to your [combat] and [agility]. Draw 1 card.

flavor: Some people need to know the truth at any cost. Some truths can cut like knives.
name: Seeking Answers
text: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering a clue at your location, discover 2 total clues from among your location and connecting locations.

flavor: At last, I've found it!
name: Perception
text:
Max 1 committed per skill test.
If this test is successful, draw 1 card (2 cards instead if it succeeds by 2 or more).

name: Forbidden Tome
text:
Researched.
[action][action][action][action] Exhaust Forbidden Tome: Move 1 damage from a player card at your location to an enemy at your location. Reduce this ability's cost by 1 action for every 4 cards in your hand (to a minimum of [action]).

name: Forbidden Tome
text:
Researched.
[action][action][action][action] Exhaust Forbidden Tome: You may move to a connecting location. Discover 1 clue at your location. Reduce this ability's cost by 1 action for every 4 cards in your hand (to a minimum of [action]).

flavor: Beyond all points in time. Beyond all angles of space. Beyond the curves of reality.
name: Farsight
text: [fast] During your turn, if you have 8 or more cards in your hand, exhaust Farsight: Play an event from your hand (paying its cost).

name: Miskatonic Archaeology Funding
text: Permanent. Limit 1 per deck. You have 2 additional ally slots, which can only be used to hold [[Miskatonic]] assets. Forced - When you take damage or horror: No more than 1 of that damage/horror can be assigned to a [[Miskatonic]] asset.

name: The Necronomicon
text:
Uses (6 secrets). Limit 1 per deck.
[fast] Spend 1 secret: You get +2 skill value for this skill test.
[fast] Spend 2 secrets: Draw 2 cards.
[fast] Spend 3 secrets: Discover 1 clue at any location.
[fast] Spend 4 secrets: Deal 3 damage to an enemy engaged with you.

back_flavor: When disaster strikes, Rex Murphy is usually on hand, suffering the consequences. After spending a day with Rex, even the most hardened skeptic will concede that the man is cursed. Anytime he had a lead on a good story, something would go wrong, like that business in Innsmouth with the photographs that blew out to sea. His terrible fortune has more than once exposed him to gruesome beasts and occult conspiracies. To survive, Rex has developed an inquisitive mind, keeping one step ahead of the next disaster.
back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Seeker cards ([seeker]) level 0-3, [[Cursed]] and [[Gambit]] cards level 0-4, Neutral cards level 0-5, up to five other Rogue cards ([rogue]) level 0. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Search for the Truth, Rex's Curse, 1 random basic weakness. Deckbuilding Restrictions: No [[Fortune]] or [[Blessed]] cards (unless they are also [[Cursed]]).

deck_options.error: You cannot have more than 5 Rogue cards.

flavor: "Oh, come on, not <u>again</u>!"
name: Rex Murphy
text:
[reaction] When you would either place 1 of your clues on your location, or add 2 [curse] tokens to the chaos bag: Do the other instead. (This can still satisfy the cost of an ability.)
[elder_sign] effect: +2 for each [curse] token revealed during this test. Draw 1 card for each [curse] token revealed during this test.

name: Search for the Truth
text:
Rex Murphy deck only. Advanced.
For each clue on Rex Murphy (to a maximum of 5) you may either:
- Draw 1 card.
- Place that clue on your location and return any card from your discard pile to your hand.

name: Rex's Curse
text: Advanced. Revelation - Put Rex's Curse into play in your threat area. Forced - When you would succeed at a skill test: Reveal an additional chaos token. If this effect causes you to fail the test, shuffle Rex's Curse into your deck. (Limit once per test.)

name: Enchanted Armor
text: Play Enchanted Armor under the control of any investigator at your location. Forced - After damage and/or horror is placed on Enchanted Armor: The owner of Enchanted Armor tests [willpower] (X), where X is the total amount of damage and horror on it. If the test fails, discard Enchanted Armor and assign the damage and/or horror just placed on it elsewhere.

name: Blessing of Isis
text: [reaction] When a second [bless] token is revealed during a single skill test at your location, exhaust Blessing of Isis: Cancel that token and treat it as if it were a [elder_sign] token instead. Return both of those tokens to the chaos bag after this test ends.

name: Cryptic Grimoire
text:
Researched.
[reaction] After you resolve 1 or more [curse] tokens during a skill test: Place that many secrets on Cryptic Grimoire.
[reaction] When you play an [[Insight]] event during your turn, spend 2 secrets: That event gains fast. Reduce its cost by 1.

name: Cryptic Grimoire
text:
Researched.
[reaction] After you resolve 1 or more [curse] tokens during a skill test: Place that many secrets on Cryptic Grimoire.
[reaction] When you would draw the top card of the encounter deck, spend 5 secrets: Draw a card from your deck instead.

name: Ríastrad
text: Fight. When you initiate this attack, add up to 3 [curse] tokens to the chaos bag. For each [curse] token added to the chaos bag in this way, you get +1 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack.

flavor: "Nothin's ever gonna be the same, Vito."
name: Tristan Botley
text:
[reaction] After your turn begins: Choose two skills. Until the start of your next turn, you get +1 to each of those skills.
[reaction] After any skill test ends in which a total of 3 or more [curse] or [bless] tokens were revealed: Play Tristan Botley from your hand, at no cost.

name: Curse of Aeons
text: [reaction] When a second [curse] token is revealed during a single skill test at your location, exhaust Curse of Aeons: Cancel that token and treat it as if it were a [skull] token instead. You may choose to remove both of those tokens from the chaos bag after the test ends.

name: Unrelenting
text:
Max 1 committed per test.
After you commit Unrelenting to a skill test, search the chaos bag for up to 3 non-[auto_fail] chaos tokens of your choice, and seal them on Unrelenting. If all 3 tokens sealed on Unrelenting are "+1,", "0," [bless], and/or [elder_sign] tokens, draw 2 cards. Release all tokens sealed here after this test ends.

name: Signum Crucis
text:
Commit only to a skill test you are performing, and only if the difficulty of that test is higher than your base skill value.
After you commit Signum Crucis to a skill test, add X [bless] tokens to the chaos bag. X is the difference between the test's difficulty and your base skill value.

back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -2 (-4 instead if there are 6 or fewer locations remaining in the Road deck).
[cultist]: -2. For each point you fail by, an investigator in your vehicle places 1 of their clues on your location.
[tablet]: -3. For each point you fail by, an investigator in your vehicle loses 1 resource.

text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1 (-3 instead if there are 6 or fewer locations remaining in the Road deck).
[cultist]: -1. For each point you fail by, an investigator in your vehicle places 1 of their clues on your location.
[tablet]: -2. For each point you fail by, an investigator in your vehicle loses 1 resource.
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail, resolve the hunter keyword on each enemy in play.

flavor: On your way to Falcon Point, you are ambushed by agents of the Order!
name: The Chase is On! (v. I)

Forced - At the end of the round: Starting with the rearmost location, set each location with no vehicles, enemies, or investigators aside, out of play (or add it to the victory display if it has Victory X and has no clues on it). text: Spawn - Rearmost location. Hunter. Massive. Retaliate. Forced - When The Terror of Devil Reef would be defeated: Instead, remove all damage from it and exhaust it. It cannot ready for the remainder of the round.

back_flavor: Just as you think you might be able to escape unscathed, you hear the telltale sputtering of your engine struggling to keep up with your demands. You curse and briefly stop your car before it stalls. You have only seconds to get it started again before the cultists catch up to you!
back_text:
Flip over each vehicle that is running, so that it is stopped.
Shuffle the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. If there are 3 or 4 investigators in the game, discard cards from the top of the encounter deck until a [[Vehicle]] enemy or Malfunction treachery is discarded. The lead investigator draws that card.
flavor: On your way to Falcon Point, you are ambushed by agents of the Order!
name: The Chase is On! (v. II)
text: As an additional cost for you to move while not in a vehicle, you must spend 2 actions. Forced - At the end of the round: Starting with the rearmost location, set each location with no vehicles, enemies, or investigators aside, out of play (or add it to the victory display if it has Victory X and has no clues on it). Stop when you reach a location with at least 1 vehicle, enemy, or investigator; or the location behind the rearmost investigator.

back_flavor:
Day is starting to break through the trees to the east, and thanks to the interference of your relentless pursuers, you still haven't made it to Falcon Point. Your car has begun to shake and stutter. You know it is only a matter of minutes before it runs out of fuel, but you have no choice. They've almost caught up to you. You force the accelerator down - 
The turn catches you by surprise. You try to skid to a halt, but it's too late. There is a brief feeling of weightlessness as the wheels leave the ground. Time slows to a crawl. Then, a whirlwind of chaos erupts around you.
The next thing you know, you are crawling out of the wreckage. You are bloody and bruised, but alive. And by some twist of fortune, your pursuers have driven past the spot of your accident. "Next time, I'm driving," Agent Harper jokes between fits of coughing.
back_text: Each investigator is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma.
flavor: The Order is out for blood!
name: Hot Pursuit
text: As an additional cost for you to move while not in a vehicle, you must spend 2 actions. Forced - At the end of the round: Starting with the rearmost location, set each location with no vehicles, enemies, or investigators aside, out of play (or add it to the victory display if it has Victory X and has no clues on it). Stop when you reach a location with at least 1 vehicle, enemy, or investigator; or the location behind the rearmost investigator.

back_flavor:
"I think we've lost them!" Agent Harper shouts, peeking her head out of your car's window. You glance at your rearview mirror and confirm that you no longer see the glaring headlights of your pursuers. Warm relief flutters through you. It's finally over.
For now.
flavor: Your only chance is to reach Falcon Point before your pursuers catch up to you.

flavor: The road continues to wind up the side of the cliff. The lighthouse beacon at the peak shines through the fog, luring you closer.
